verdict.rationale: Lever's only relevant evidence is a vague comparison-page claim of 'Custom, flexible configurations' versus 'Standard, rigid workflows', plus Automation Hub rule-based advancing, tagging and archiving of candidates. That glancingly suggests configurable workflows and automated stage movement, but none of the story's specific mechanics are documented. Missing for 10: documented custom pipeline stages per job, drag-to-move candidates between stages, manual bulk actions across the pipeline, in-depth first-party pipeline docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline

citations.quote: Custom, flexible configurations ... Standard, rigid workflows
Lever's Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates.
